correctness.rationale: Let C=||id:E1→E2||cb. The n-fold Haagerup/minimal tensor functoriality gives ||S_n(T)||E2≤C^n||S_n(T)||E1, so after roots and limits both spectral radii satisfy ρE2(T)≤CρE1(T). For each nonzero X∈M_m(C^d), Tornes Corollary 3.2 constructs the same infinite-dimensional tuple T_X simultaneously for all structures E with ρE(T_X)=ρE^min(T_X)=||X||E. Hence its nonzero ratio equals the m-level norm ratio; sup_m,X=C, yielding both equalities. This is correct but its mathematical ingredients are previously published, and finite matrices need not suffice as witnesses.
